svg.title: GreenSpark Dispatch Desk - Customer calls (design image)
svg.desc: High-fidelity design image of the customer battery activation screen at 1440 x 900: decision view as of 09:00 and a separate retrospective contract-period evaluation. Design prototype - illustrative data; not connected to the model.
svg.text: Design prototype - illustrative data; not connected to the model
Design image · every value is illustrative
As of Wed 14 Jan 2026, 09:00 AWST · Offer: Custom 85 c/kWh, 45 calls · Scenario S3 Synergy TPA, 50% share (hypothetical)
Price spike risk is high today; it never
Shows only what was known at 09:00 on 14 Jan
Not yet known at the decision time
Switch to Season review to see the whole season, labelled hindsight
Bars: daily peak operational demand on past days (assumed published by 09:00 the next day). Today: AEMO forecast issued before 09:00.
The capacity value of a call is settled once per season on the 12 peak intervals. It is not known at 09:00.
Contract year 2025-26 replay · 1 Jul 2025 – 30 Jun 2026 · 365 days · in-sample · S3, 50% share (hypothetical)
Customer net vs normal self-use, per home
Worst Hot Season for Zenith, 2023-24 to 2025-26
Reference terms: public Synergy Battery Rewards terms used for comparison; not a Zenith tariff or contract.
A positive verdict needs customers no worse off, zero hard-constraint violations and no Hot Season losing money.
Same dispatch model and call-rule family in every column. Peak days and settlement are known only after the season.
Each step is one call. Dashed lines are the annual caps.
Calls after the cap is used up are not possible, even on a peak day.
